question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 65, 41, 96, 44, 38, 30, 79, 90 and 21 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Arithmetic mean = Sum of observations ÷ Total number of observations

Sum of observations = 65 + 41 + 96 + 44 + 38 + 30 + 79 + 90 + 21 = 504

Total number of observations = 9

Arithmetic mean = 504 ÷ 9 = 56

**∴ Answer = 56**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations = 65, 41, 96, 44, 38, 30, 79, 90, 21

Total number of observations = 9

**Formula used:**

Arithmetic mean = Sum of observations ÷ Total number of observations

 Observations: 65, 41, 96, 44, 38, 30, 79, 90, 21 Sum of observations = 504 Total number of observations = 9 Arithmetic mean = 504 ÷ 9 = 56 

**Calculations:**

Sum of observations = 65 + 41 + 96 + 44 + 38 + 30 + 79 + 90 + 21 = 504

⇒ Arithmetic mean = 504 ÷ 9 = 56

**∴ The correct answer is 56.**
